lane_single_method_paragraph: Label-blind, catalogue-free cross-sensor scale-space orientation persistence: derive Gaussian derivative edge states at 150, 300 and 600 m from cached RTP magnetics, isostatic gravity anomaly, and detrended elevation; require geometric persistence and doubled-angle orientation confluence across the three fields, with depth-to-conductive-base amplitude used only as a named raw control. Train the shared HGB holdout model on this block plus those four source amplitudes; emit a fixed 37,654-dot, 2.8-pixel-separated, >3-pixel-catalogue-excluded field.

hypothesis.signature: geometric mean edge strength across sigma={1.5,3.0,6.0} pixels plus doubled-angle orientation concentration and cross-sensor vector confluence
hypothesis.off_catalogue_mechanism: a concealed basin-boundary or normal-fault contact can preserve a stable structural axis in independent magnetic, density and relief fields without a mapped surface trace
hypothesis.non_fault_mimic: intrusive or lithologic contacts, survey flight-line seams, pluvial shoreline/terrace edges, and drainage margins
hypothesis.difference_from_repo: no prior checked method uses steerable/doubled-angle cross-scale persistence; this lane excludes catalogue-derived mechanics, SGMC targets, GDR point proximity and prior prediction rasters

holdout.split: buffered whole-component quadrant draw, seed 20 primary and seed 30 confirmation, hide_frac=0.20, feature buffer=3 px, boundary erosion=12 px
holdout.incumbent_label: HOLDOUT-DTI, H77-Step receipt, seed 20, 11,321 withheld positives, 95% CI [0.131548, 0.175185]

gates.surface_before_placement: No checked registry raster may have |Spearman| > 0.90 or forward 3-pixel overlap > 0.70; incomplete registry is reported as not certified.
gates.final_dots: Repeat the same comparison after dot placement; a dense space-filling witness remains a literal blocker under Policy I17.
gates.promotion: Only a seed-20 primary improvement over incumbent plus a confirmation and all gates could be a candidate for separate selector sign-off; no weekly slot is selected here.
